description: Melani Dilkushi Silva nee Gomes v. Mareena Wyman Melani Dilkushi Silva nee Gomes v. Mareena Wyman View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Melani Dilkushi Silva nee Gomes v. Mareena Wyman Melani Dilkushi Silva nee Gomes v. Mareena Wyman View More
keywords: The Appellants appealed against the District Court order dismissing the action for declaration of title, ejectment of the Respondent and damages on preliminary issues; Respondent maintained no cause of action. Held - Based on the evidence placed before Court, plain reading of the plaint shows cause of action; District Court order set aside and case sent for retrial. Appeal allowed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
